title: Simplify the feed decorator
bug: The feed is oldest-first instead of newest-first.

findings.detail: changed: data.*.id x8, data.*.text x7, data.*.url x7, data.*.author.about_me x4, +6 more
findings.label: regression
findings.why: Removing the explicit order_direction='desc' argument changes the default ordering from descending to ascending timestamp, causing different posts to appear first in the feed.

findings.detail: changed: data.*.id x2, data.*.text x2, data.*.url x2, data.*.author.about_me, +6 more

findings.label: regression
findings.why: Removing the explicit order_direction='desc' argument changes the default ordering from descending to ascending timestamp, causing different posts to appear first in the feed.

doppel_guided.summary: The PR removes the explicit descending order direction, which changes the feed ordering from newest-first to oldest-first, a regression not announced in the description.

suspicions.claim: The feed endpoint may change sort order from descending to ascending because the explicit order_direction='desc' argument was removed and the paginated_response default is 'asc'.
suspicions.trigger: Create two posts from followed users with different timestamps. GET /api/feed with a valid Bearer token. Read response.json['data'][0]['timestamp'] and response.json['data'][1]['timestamp']. If the first timestamp is older than the second, the order has flipped to ascending.
